caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of a textile with a central oval medallion. The medallion is pink with a yellow border and features a symmetrical white floral or leafy pattern in the center. Surrounding the medallion, the background is primarily taupe or light beige, adorned with swirling and curvilinear designs in white and subtle orange-yellow shades. The composition is accented by several pink and orange abstract shapes and brown geometric objects arranged symmetrically. Near the edges of the textile, there are additional ornamental shapes, including stylized floral motifs in yellow, brown, and pink. The entire design is rendered with uniform horizontal lines, suggesting a woven or tapestry texture. The overall color palette consists of pink, beige, white, brown, orange, and yellow. The drawing is set against a plain, unadorned off-white background.
title: Brussels Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
